parole.significato: A Muslim people originally from north-west China who currently reside in Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and Russia.
parole.testo: From Turkic [Term?], probably via Russian, originally referring to any Hui Chinese. It is an exonym. Chinese scholar Lin Tao compiles a list of possible etymologies in Donggan yü lungao (2007): * From Chinese 東甘 /东甘 (dōng Gān, literally “Eastern Gan[su]”) — by a Russian consul in Ghulja of the name

parole.significato: A skilled horseman in the Caucasus and Central Asia.
parole.testo: From Turkic languages (compare Nogai йигит (yigit), Tatar егет (yeget, “young male”)), via Russian джиги́т (džigít).
